title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 254 ]

blocks.text: There is no doubt that our education does not meet high standards in such basic skills as mathematics and language. And we realize that our youngsters are ignorant of Latin, put Mussolini in the same category as Dostoevski and cannot recite the Periodic Table by heart. Would we, however, prefer to fill the developing minds of our children with hundreds of geometry problems or the names of all the rivers in the world? Do we really want to frustrate their opportunities for self-expression?
